title: Ilizwi Elivela Kwityholo Elivuthayo
intro: Cacisa ubuwena bomntu onzulu ohambo lwakhe lwaqala ngokudibana okumangalisayo kwaye ikamva lakhe lalidibene nokukhululwa kwabantu abacinezelweyo. Lo mntu wakhethwa ngenxa yomsebenzi omkhulu, ejongene nemingeni emikhulu ngenkxaso kaThixo.
clues: Ndazalelwa kwixesha lengcinezelo enkulu, apho iintsana zabantu bakowethu zazibulawa khona.
Ubomi bam bokuqala babuquka ukufakwa emlanjeni ngumzali wam, kodwa ndafunyanwa ndaza ndakhulela kwikhaya lomcinezeli wabantu bakuthi.
Ndakha ndabaleka kwisixeko emva kokuba ndibangele ukufa komntu ngempazamo ngexesha lengxabano.
Ndifumene umyalezo ongcwele nentonga engummangaliso kwindawo engcwele, apho ndayalelwa ukuba ndijongane nomlawuli onamandla.
Umnakwethu wonyulwa njengomncedisi kum kumsebenzi wam, ngenxa yokuba ndandingathethi kakuhle.
Ndakhokela abantu bam ukuwela ulwandle olwaluqhekekile, ndibaleka ukusukelwa ngumkhosi okhohlakeleyo.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
